key_insight: Sensitivity analysis helps anticipate which bubbly-liquid parameters a physics-informed neural network can recover from nonlinear waveforms.
engineering_relevance: The framework could support characterization of bubbly media for ultrasound-based biomedical and industrial applications.
method: Model weakly nonlinear wave propagation with a Korteweg–de Vries–Burgers equation.
Assess eight physical parameters through coefficient- and solution-level sensitivity analysis.
Use a physics-informed neural network for forward prediction and seven single-parameter inverse estimations.
evidence_signal: The PINN reproduced the reference solution and estimated viscosity, initial bubble radius, density, sound speed, and pressure with 0.8–2.1% errors; the polytropic exponent converged partially, while surface tension estimation failed.
watch_item: Single-parameter recovery does not establish reliable simultaneous estimation, especially for weakly sensitive parameters.
paper_title: Sensitivity-Guided Parameter Estimation of Bubbly Liquid via a Nonlinear Wave Equation and Physics-InformedNeuralNetworks
